query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.nameJa, ds.sourceUrl, ds.sourceIdentifier 
FROM cards c 
JOIN dataSources ds ON c.id = ds.cardId 
WHERE ds.source = 'snkrdunk' AND (ds.sourceUrl LIKE '%96659%' OR ds.sourceIdentifier = '96659') 
LIMIT 5;
